headline: The 10-year
yield fell
0.15 points
in a week
slides.subtitle:
From 5.24% to 5.09%
after a tech selloff

slides.title: What happened
slides.body: The Treasury par yield was 5.24% on Oct 9 and 5.09% on Oct 16. Most of the drop came on Oct 15.
slides.source: Source: U.S. Treasury daily par yield curve

slides.title: The numbers
slides.subtitle: 10-year Treasury yield, %
slides.body: A fall in yield means bond prices rose.
slides.source: Source: U.S. Treasury, Oct 9 to Oct 16, 2026

slides.title: Why it matters
slides.body: Mortgages and business loans often follow Treasury yields. At 5.09%, the 10-year is still well above 5%.
slides.source: Reports linked the move to a tech selloff

slides.title: Bottom line
items: Down 15 basis points in a week
slides.disclaimer: For informational purposes only. Not investment advice.
